limits: PowerPoint physical shortcut and Office native Command+Z were not verified this run
Cancellation, lost receipts, conflicts and failure preservation are covered by regression tests, not a new live network fault injection
PowerPoint text requires one uniform paragraph without links, fields or animation; Chinese needs an explicitly defined font
Picture masks are retained within the current revision chain, not recovered as source semantics after task end or restart
At most 20 in-memory revisions per task; no restart recovery
Unknown host write outcomes freeze rather than automatically retry or rollback
Restoration does not imply byte-identical Office files or stable recreated picture IDs
